title: Cracked asphalt
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of asphalt paving: aggregate stones in bitumen, wandering and branching cracks, alligator cracking, tar sealant and stains. Use for roads, parking lots and urban ground.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python asphalt_cracked.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: aggregate_size
parameters.meaning: Aggregate stones across the tile (higher is finer).

parameters.name: cracks
parameters.meaning: Main cracks wandering across the tile; each may branch.

parameters.name: crack_width
parameters.meaning: Main crack width in texture units.

parameters.name: sealant
parameters.meaning: Glossy tar sealant painted over the main cracks.

parameters.name: wear
parameters.meaning: Binder worn off the stone tops: 0 fresh black, 1 old grey.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Worn grey road asphalt with a few long cracks.

presets.name: fresh
presets.description: New black asphalt with no cracks.

presets.name: alligator
presets.description: Old pavement with fatigue cracking and stains.

presets.name: sealed
presets.description: Repaired asphalt with tar sealant over the cracks.

presets.name: coarse_chip
presets.description: Coarse chip seal with large, light stones.

limits: There are no lane markings, potholes or curbs. Cracks are random walks and fatigue cracks are Voronoi borders, approximations of real failure patterns. Aggregate stones are flat Voronoi cells. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Worley noise cells as aggregate stones
Branching random walks drawn as capsule paths for cracks
Thresholded Worley borders for alligator cracking
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
